title: K18, Dyson, DSM-Firmenich and Aora named among Time’s best inventions of 2026
summary: Time magazine’s annual list of the best inventions has spotlighted several beauty and self care launches, including Dyson’s CameraJet toothbrush and plastic free Mexican make-up brand Aora
